name: 42-gh-registry
commandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$roots = @(\"HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*\", \"HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*\", \"HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*\"); $found=@(Get-ItemProperty $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq \"GitHub CLI\" } | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallLocation); ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $found -Compress"
